highlights.title: Plan limits in Settings
highlights.line: Settings, AI Models now shows a Claude account's five-hour limit, and a ChatGPT sign-in's plan limits as Codex last reported them.

highlights.title: Accounts on your other computers
highlights.line: Settings, AI Models also lists your other computers: each one's Claude accounts, their weekly usage and the agents on them.

highlights.title: Move several agents, or stop a move
highlights.line: Moving several agents to another account no longer freezes the board, and a running move can be stopped; agents it had not reached stay put.

highlights.title: Every permission choice is a button
highlights.line: An agent's permission question shows every choice it offers; one that changes what the agent may do from now on takes a second press.

highlights.title: An agent needs no project
highlights.line: An agent on no project is no longer flagged: the No project tile is gone, and a new team's Project is optional.
